component.name: DeepSeek Harness Desktop
component.summary: DeepSeek Harness 的原生桌面壳

description.p: DeepSeek Harness Desktop runs the official DeepSeek Harness (dsh) WebUI in a native Tauri window. It starts dsh web, waits for its local URL and embeds the UI with the system WebView. Credentials, plugins and agent permissions stay in ~/.dsh.
The app bundles ModLens for text-only vision, a settings page at 设置 → 视觉模型, and the community Anchored Standard presets. The Flatpak also bundles Node.js and @deepseek-ai/dsh.
Tauri shell with an Apple-style title bar, bundled dsh, and on-launch updates.
